description: This PHP source file is part of a CRM system (vtiger CRM). It handles the logic for adding products to a price book, including displaying a list of available products with filtering, sorting, and selection functionalities, as well as permission checks and UI rendering using Smarty templates.

classes.name: Products
classes.description: A class representing product entities within the CRM system.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty templating class used for rendering UI components in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getPricesForProducts
methods.description: Retrieves price information for a list of products in a specified currency.

methods.name: getListQuery
methods.description: Generates a SQL query to retrieve a list of products based on certain criteria.

methods.name: return_module_language
methods.description: Fetches language strings for a specified module based on current language settings.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Returns the parent tab or section name in the CRM interface.

methods.name: getPriceBookName
methods.description: Returns the name of the price book given its ID.

methods.name: get_form_header
methods.description: Generates HTML for form header in Smarty templates.

methods.name: getFieldVisibilityPermission
methods.description: Checks user permissions for visibility of specific fields.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has permission to perform certain actions on entities.
